skill_focus._why: Foundry fixes acr; the player picks the skill, one pick per instance, and instances must name different skills.

student._why: Lashunta trait text: +2 species bonus to any two skills of their choice.

observant._why: Trait text: select either Perception or Sense Motive.

channel_skill_(su)._why: The two skills belong to the mystic connection, so they are derived, not picked.

resistance_(ex_exocortex)._why: Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic; each selection must use a different type.

greater_resistance_(ex_exocortex)._why: Applies to a different type each time, and only to one that already has the Resistance mod.

resistant_energy_(ex)._why: Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic.

improved_resistant_energy_(ex)._why: Resistance 15 against the original type and one additional chosen type.

weapon_focus_(combat)._why: Weapon type is stored at levels[i].choices[featSlug] and applied by gear.attackLines through gear.FEAT_CHOICE.

armor_ease._why: Toggle for worn armor; handled by the armor condition on the modifiers.

half-ryphorian._why: Text asks to emulate stacking by hand; resistances are fixed cold and fire.

steelskin._why: Text asks to hand-edit DR for level and stacking; no player choice.

hardened_systems._why: Text asks to toggle and adjust for stacking; the electricity resistance is fixed.

inured_to_the_grave._why: Text asks to adjust for greater cold resistance from another source; no player choice.

arcane_armor_(su)._why: Toggle for the spell siphon save bonus; no player choice.

celestial_-_first_lesson._why: Damage reduction value depends on spell level at use time; no player choice.

fiend_-_first_lesson._why: Damage reduction value depends on spell level at use time; no player choice.

deflecting_smash_(ex)._why: Toggle between the +1 and +2 critical-hit bonus; no player choice.

explosive_meditation._why: Toggle for graviton or photon mode bonuses; no player choice.

into_the_unknown_(ex)._why: Toggle for the initiative bonus; the skill bonuses are fixed.

solar_armor._why: Cold or fire is switched as a move action in play; sheet keeps the fixed default.

stalwart_shield_(su)._why: Grants cold and fire resistance together while active; the type is not a choice.

stellar_sage._why: Replacement values are accounted for by the existing Solarian modifiers; no player choice.
